code_readback.clip_source_field_not_applicable: Still data.source is unsupported; no alias or custom video schema field was invented.
code_readback.native_supported_route: Official keyframes --shot with the ordinary exact-request cache, independently judged at both endpoints.
code_readback.cache_identity: The pure local Stage.imageKey was called with declared model/version/size and full request inputs. Scene ID and output target do not enter the native key.
code_readback.camera_matters: Camera is part of composed prompt and must be identical.
code_readback.guard_is_read_only: Use readCache plus existsSync and SHA of actual bytes. Never use cached() as a read-only guard: it can delete an invalid entry and write cache.json.

pairs.no_result_drawn_in_teaser: Adult pauses over a face-down unmarked sheet before sealing; no filled address, checkbox, request or completed form is shown.

production_handoff.on_any_failure_or_changed_request: Stop the pair. No separate reroll, force, accept-best bypass, independent look-alike purchase or hand-written manifest. Correct both endpoints together, repeat normal bound source/visual review and admission.
actual_verification_required: Both endpoints must pass their own ordinary official judge verdict.
After the official commands, read manifest shots for the pair, require identical selected file reference and SHA, then hash the actual bytes.
If trimming occurs, require identical final trimmed selected file and SHA at both endpoints; matching original-generated hashes alone is insufficient.
Hash original cache bytes and final selected bytes separately; do not assume original and trimmed SHA are equal.
Read final assembly inputs and require the same selected file at teaser and payoff. Preserve normal job/cache/ledger receipts.
